related.title: DenseNet：串接增長與特徵再用
related.titleEn: DenseNet: concatenation growth and feature reuse
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三塊梯度圖、差分表與旁路斷圖測試。；中心差分與解析值誤差小於教學1e−6，並列出線性假設與投影例外。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a three-block gradient graph, finite-difference table and shortcut-detachment test.; Finite differences agree within teaching tolerance1e−6, with linear assumptions and projection exceptions stated.
related.difference: 為24、36、48、60、72通道畫五個節點，標每層新12通道的索引區間。；末層72與56通道均可重建，並把保留激活與權重記憶體分開列帳。
related.differenceEn: Draw widths24,36,48,60,72 and label the12 newly appended channels at each layer.; Reconstruct72 and56 channels and account for retained activations separately from weight storage.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化標量塊y=x+ax，局部導數為1+a；串接L塊為(1+a)^L，僅限線性無激活示例。；教學a=0.1、L=3，與a=−0.1比較；不是實際ResNet訓練結果。；g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331；a=−0.1時g=0.729。
初始C0、每層新增k通道時，L層後C=C0+Lk；串接保留舊通道而非相加。；教學C0=24、k=12、L=4，H=W=8。；C=24+4×12=72；k=8時C=56。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For scalar y=x+ax, the local derivative is1+a; L blocks give(1+a)^L, limited to this linear example without activations.; Teaching a=0.1,L=3, compared with a=−0.1; these are not measured ResNet training results.; g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331; at a=−0.1,g=0.729.
Starting width C0 and growth k yield C=C0+Lk after L layers; concatenation retains earlier channels.; Teaching C0=24,k=12,L=4,H=W=8.; C=24+4×12=72; k=8 gives C=56.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Faster R-CNN：錨框候選與共享特徵
related.titleEn: Faster R-CNN: anchor proposals and shared features
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三塊梯度圖、差分表與旁路斷圖測試。；中心差分與解析值誤差小於教學1e−6，並列出線性假設與投影例外。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a three-block gradient graph, finite-difference table and shortcut-detachment test.; Finite differences agree within teaching tolerance1e−6, with linear assumptions and projection exceptions stated.
related.difference: 為單個特徵中心列9組尺度比例，再標影像座標、邊界裁切及物件性分數。；3600及2400可核對，IoU基本案例正確且窄框召回差異有證據。
related.differenceEn: Enumerate nine scale-ratio pairs at one feature center and annotate image coordinates, clipping and objectness.; Counts and basic IoUs match, with evidence for narrow-box recall differences.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化標量塊y=x+ax，局部導數為1+a；串接L塊為(1+a)^L，僅限線性無激活示例。；教學a=0.1、L=3，與a=−0.1比較；不是實際ResNet訓練結果。；g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331；a=−0.1時g=0.729。
每位置a個錨框，候選數HWa；這是篩選前數量，不等於最終偵測數。；教學H=W=20，3尺度×3比例=9錨框；改3尺度×2比例。；N=20×20×9=3600；6錨框時2400。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For scalar y=x+ax, the local derivative is1+a; L blocks give(1+a)^L, limited to this linear example without activations.; Teaching a=0.1,L=3, compared with a=−0.1; these are not measured ResNet training results.; g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331; at a=−0.1,g=0.729.
With a anchors per position, proposals number HWa before filtering, not final detections.; Teaching20×20 map with3 scales×3 ratios=9 anchors; compare3×2.; N=20×20×9=3600; six anchors give2400.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
